meta.name: depmap
meta.description: Query the Cancer Dependency Map (DepMap) for cancer cell line gene dependency scores (CRISPR Chronos), drug sensitivity data, and gene effect profiles. Use for identifying cancer-specific vulnerabilities, synthetic lethal interactions, and validating oncology drug targets.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询癌症依赖图谱数据，发现肿瘤靶点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在癌症研究中使用DepMap数据筛选基因依赖或药物敏感性。
copy.tagline_en: Query cancer dependency map data to discover tumor targets.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to analyze cancer gene dependencies or drug sensitivity data from DepMap.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以查询癌症依赖图谱（DepMap）数据库，获取特定基因在数百种癌细胞系中的 CRISPR 依赖分数（Chronos）、基因效应概况和药物敏感性数据，用于识别癌症选择性脆弱性和合成致死相互作用。
howto.when: 当你询问特定基因在癌症细胞系中的依赖分数、药物敏感性数据，或要求进行靶点验证、合成致死分析等生物信息学任务时触发。

say.text: 查询KRAS在肺癌细胞系中的依赖分数。
say.note: 返回Chronos分数及依赖细胞系列表。

say.text: 分析BRCA1突变细胞系的合成致死搭档。
say.note: 找出在突变系中更必需的基因。

say.text: 获取DepMap中所有胰腺癌细胞系的信息。
say.note: 显示细胞系名称、疾病和谱系。

howto.what_en: This skill enables Claude to query the Cancer Dependency Map (DepMap) for CRISPR dependency scores (Chronos), gene effect profiles, and drug sensitivity data across hundreds of cancer cell lines, helping identify cancer-selective vulnerabilities and synthetic lethal interactions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for dependency scores of a gene in specific cancer cell lines, drug sensitivity data, or request target validation, synthetic lethality analysis, or similar bioinformatics tasks.

say_en.text: Query the dependency score of KRAS in lung cancer cell lines.
say_en.note: Returns Chronos scores and dependent cell lines.

say_en.text: Analyze synthetic lethal partners for BRCA1-mutant cell lines.
say_en.note: Identifies genes more essential in mutant lines.

say_en.text: Get info on all pancreatic cancer cell lines in DepMap.
say_en.note: Shows cell line names, diseases, and lineages.
